thread:
maya: Heads-up — building the SI onboarding lab runbook for the pilot cohort. Need a short, practical doc that covers: access, hw booking, marketplace listing walkthrough, cert badge flow, and incident escalation. Can someone own the runbook draft?

samir: Ill own lab infra + booking. Already talked to RackScale and CloudWaves partner reps. We can reserve H100 and Ampere seats for the first two weeks of the pilot. Need to confirm time slots (day vs night) for partner engineers support.

lena: Ill draft the runbook sections: access & creds, quickstart checklist, smoke tests, and remediation playbook. Will add a short "what to expect" intro for SIs.

alex: I can do the marketplace listing step-by-step and the cert badge mechanics (how badge awarded + revocation rules). Also want a 5-min video demo we can embed in the playbook.

partners-bot: Partners: RackScale (H100) available 9am-5pm PT Mon-Fri, CloudWave (Ampere) confirmed weekend block 10am-4pm Sat-Sun. EdgeBox pending confirmation.

maya: Good. Key constraints: 1) limit access tokens to 24h ephemeral tokens for lab users; 2) ensure KMS keys are cross-account limited; 3) marketplace listing must not use prod credentials. Add these as bold items in runbook.

samir: For vouchers: I'll provision 20 single-day vouchers + 10 multi-day passes. Sampler script for provisioning below (ops use only):
```
# allocate voucher
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/vouchers \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"type":"single-day","count":20,"notes":"SI pilot"}'
```

lena: Nice. For smoke tests, include tokenized perf run and minimal latency check. Example command:
```
# smoke test
python perf_check.py --model rdx-small --seq 512 --iters 10
```
Expect < 150ms p50 on H100 for rdx-small.

alex: Certification flow proposal: micro-quiz (15 Qs) -> lab practical (deploy + listing) -> customer scenario (simulate outage + recovery). Passing threshold 75%. Badge auto-issued via cert-service after lab verification.

maya: Add an escalation matrix in runbook: partner oncall -> integrations lead -> ops-sre. Include SLAs: first response 2h, escalation 6h, outbreak call < 12h.

samir: Ops checklist (short): network CIDR allowlist, VPC peering template, KMS role ARN, ECR repo write, quota bump ticket link. I'll attach the template to the runbook.

lena: I want a tiny "troubleshooting" section with common failures and quick fixes: container OOM, KV cache thrash, missing env var, cert auth failure. Will add example logs and grep commands.

alex: For the lab exercises, propose 3 lanes: dev (quick walkthru), integrator (full listing + CI), and verification (performance + SLO test). We should label each lane with expected time: 30m / 2h / 1h.

maya: Action items: Samir = voucher & ops template (Wed EOD), Lena = runbook draft + troubleshooting (Thu), Alex = marketplace walkthrough + video script (Thu), Maya = escalation matrix & cert-service flow (Fri).

partners-bot: Reminder: schedule kickoff sync — created event "SI Onboard Lab Runbook Kickoff" Thu 10:30 PT.

samir: One operational ask: can we get partner support windows documented (phone + escalation emails) in the runbook? Will be critical for out-of-hours issues.

maya: Yup, will request partner ops contacts. Also prepping a short "how to request emergency support" doc for SIs.

lena: I'll drop the first draft as a gist and link in this thread once ready.

alex: Also, can we include a tiny consent checkbox on enrollment: partner NDA + ephemeral data retention policy. Legal OK?

maya: I'll check with legal and update.

partners-bot: Reaction logged: :white_check_mark: kickoff scheduled.

lena: Thanks team  will ping again when draft is live.
